card.name: Words completing calculation or adjustment phrases
card.fires_on: Words like calculated, normalized, indicated, and the word to in 'adjust pH' or 'make up to volume', where a phrase about computing, adjusting or basing something is being completed.

modes.label: Calculated as
modes.description: The word calculated (or its stem) in phrases saying a value is computed as a base or by a method.
modes.example: The oral LD 50 of amiloride hydrochloride (cal<<culated>> as the base) is 56

modes.label: Adjust or make up to
modes.description: The word to after adjust or make the suspension, in preparation and formulation text.
modes.example: • Make the suspension<< to>> volume (100 mL) with

modes.label: Other passive verbs
modes.description: Passive verbs such as normalized or indicated that finish a clause about how something is set or shown.
modes.example: References to chapters and sections are<< indicated>> with corresponding chapter and section numbers in square

card.writes: It lowers the odds of repeat or confirm words, so the text moves on instead of repeating or confirming.
card.plain: It marks spots where a label says how a value is worked out or adjusted, such as 'calculated as the base' or 'adjust pH'.
